title: The tailgate's rust
logline: The Legacy's tailgate, close, rust through the paint at the hinge, the flats beyond, a thermos ring in the rust. Fourteen years of mornings on one hinge. The page draws the ring.

panels.composition: Close on a station wagon's open tailgate rusted through at the hinge with a thermos ring stained into the rust, mudflats beyond.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, close on an old station wagon's open tailgate rusted through at the hinge with a thermos ring stained into the rust, tidal flats beyond, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
